newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMRO UNIT EXPANDS IN ST PETERSBURG.
newsitem.headline: TAMRO UNIT EXPANDS IN ST PETERSBURG.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Oy Tamro Ab said in a statement on Wednesday its Russian joint venture, Pharm Tamda 77, would open a new distribution center in St Petersburg.
The new premises were needed due to increased business volumes and for better customer service, Tamro said.
The unit's market share in pharmaceutical distribution in St Petersburg is almost 15 percent, Tamro said.

"Besides the city of St Petersburg and the surrounding Leningrad Region, the company's operations cover today Murmansk, Archangelsk, Petrozavodsk, Pskov, Novgorod and Kaliningrad, with a total population of approximately 13 million people," it said.
Tamro holds 60 percent of Pharm Tamda and its Russian partners hold 40 percent, Tamro said.
